## About
TNS Autosports started as a car audio and customization shop right here in the Kansas City area. As our customers asked for more, we added a lot full of hand-selected pre-owned cars, trucks and SUVs, a full service department, and financing that works for real people.
Today it all happens at our North Kansas City location on Burlington St. You can buy a vehicle, get it serviced, and add tint, a lift kit or a sound system without going anywhere else. Bought your car somewhere else? We'll still take care of it.
We're not a big-box dealer chain. We live here and we serve here, and we'll shoot straight with you. That's how we've earned a 4.9 rating from 49 Google reviews.

## Services
- Pre-Owned Car Sales: Quality used cars, trucks and SUVs, hand-picked and inspected, across a wide price range.
- Flexible Financing: Financing options that actually work for real people, whether your credit is perfect, rebuilding or somewhere in between.
- Auto Repairs & Tires: Oil changes, brake service, check engine light diagnostics, A/C and heating, battery and electrical, transmission, and alignment and suspension work.
- Tire Center: New tires, rotations, balancing, flat repair and TPMS service for cars, trucks and SUVs. Rotations are free when you buy new tires.
- Auto Detailing: Interior and exterior detailing packages to restore and protect your vehicle.
- Aftermarket Upgrades & Accessories: Custom sound systems, remote starts, window tint, lift kits, wheels and tires, installed by our team.
- Window Tinting: Ceramic, high-performance or non-reflective tint for your car, truck or SUV.
- Lift Kits and Suspension: Suspension, body and leveling lift kits, plus lowering springs for performance cars.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for maintenance?
A: Walk-ins are welcome whenever possible, but we recommend booking ahead so we can get to you promptly.

Q: How long does an oil change take?
A: A standard oil change typically takes about 30 to 45 minutes, depending on your vehicle and how busy the shop is.

Q: Can I get approved with bad credit?
A: Yes. Bad credit, no credit or a bankruptcy, we've helped customers in every situation get approved.

Q: Will you work on a car I didn't buy from you?
A: Yes. Bring it in and our techs will take care of it.
